title: Curious Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: A palm-sized cuttlefish drifts through a dusky blue tank of swaying kelp and smooth river stones, rippling looping, handwriting-like patterns across its skin whenever someone lingers at the glass, as if trying to start a conversation. Between visitors, it patiently nudges pebbles into small spirals on the sand, and no one is quite sure whether these are notes, gifts, or questions.
